entries.speaker: Ohya

entries.speaker: Chief
entries.en: I expect your resignation letter[n]on my desk next week. If it doesn't[n]come, I'll handle matters myself.

entries.speaker: Chief

entries.en: Thanks. That guy is one of the execs over[n]at my job.

entries.speaker: Ohya
